scope: Endorsement of bounded research/specification direction, not implementation adoption or a discharged theorem. Independently checked against the authorization study and the appended four clarifications.

caveats.detail: At formalization time distinguish valid historical consent, current revocation/key state and the stage policy deciding which applies. Bind principal-to-key interpretation and the authenticated state domain; a signed stale root does not establish current authority. The proposal already leaves these as pinned premises rather than claiming automatic PCD freshness.

A hidden root authorization context must be proved and bound to the real predecessor. Internal authorization of a revealed subtree is insufficient. The proposal scope and commitment language permit this obligation; it must remain explicit in a future relation.

Formal intention may authorize multiple admissible plans and standing delegation. Do not silently strengthen exact binding into a requirement for fresh signatures on every descendant action or one fixed prepared transaction. Material duty changes and policy-permitted changes need separate judgments.

The new genesis, well-founded composition, completeness and migration paragraphs address the main authority blockers. Preserve actual ledger uniqueness, complete residual-duty accounting and unchanged recovery rights as separate proof or assumption obligations.
The current study is documentation-level semantic analysis with derived negative witnesses, not executable Daml tests, a source audit, PCD construction or ZKIRv3 correspondence proof.

evidence_that_would_change_vote: An acceptance relation allowing arbitrary Approved/funded genesis or omission of an outstanding obligation from a private predecessor projection.
Treating any signed event chain as PCD, accepting prover-chosen verifier keys without relation binding, or treating recursive validity as ledger double-spend prevention.
Importing package-vetting/participant-admin/project-registry admission as a Moriarty developer gate.
Claiming compatible record schemas preserve signed economics, or allowing an upgrade to erase recovery rights or persistent liabilities without authorized amendment.
Claiming local authorization, honest witness generation, bounded execution or an authenticated external attestation alone proves the complete formal intention on Midnight.
